ScenarioName: Zero-Config 1-Second Boarding (QR Scan Start) & Garage Auto-Return
StepsSummary: 1) Select a driver/idle vehicle in the Employee Mobile App -> 2) Click [1-Sec Key QR Start] -> 3) Click [Auto-Return to HQ Garage]
ExpectedResults_CheckPoints: Switches to normal operation (AUTHORIZED) in 1 second with no manual Bluetooth pairing / IRS Mileage Log entry (+16.4 km) auto-recorded on garage return

ScenarioName: Standard 4-Stage Dispatch Lifecycle (Request->Approve->In Use->Return) & Persistent DB Check
StepsSummary: 1) Request a vehicle on mobile (REQUESTED) -> 2) Admin approval (APPROVED) -> 3) Key pickup & start of use (IN_USE) -> 4) Return complete (RETURNED) and F5 refresh
ExpectedResults_CheckPoints: 4-stage status transitions and bilateral push notifications logged / 100% of data preserved in the backend DB after a browser refresh (F5)

ScenarioName: Unauthorized Removal While Key Manager Is Away (Red Alert) · Co-Passenger Separation · Depart-first, report-later
StepsSummary: 1) Check co-passenger in the [Sensor · Alert Test] tab -> 2) Click [Unauthorized Start (15 km/h+)] -> 3) After the alert click [Submit Reason]
ExpectedResults_CheckPoints: KPI Red Alert +1 / Primary driver identified via key box BLE (3 m) entry order and RSSI (-46 dBm vs -74 dBm) / Switches to Depart-first, report-later after reason is submitted

ScenarioName: No-Dashcam Smartphone 6-Axis IMU Crash Reconstruction vs. Phone Drop False-Positive Filter
StepsSummary: 1) Click [Phone Drop] to verify the false-positive filter -> 2) Click [3.2G Crash] to verify the 6-axis IMU crash report and 30-sec deceleration graph
ExpectedResults_CheckPoints: Mounted-phone drop (3.4G / Δv=0 km/h) excluded as false positive / Real crash (3.24G + gyro 38.4°/s + hard stop) produces a crash report with street name and coordinates auto-recorded

ScenarioName: Intentional Permission Evasion (BT OFF) Detection & Ghost Trip Discovery via Actual Odometer Audit
StepsSummary: 1) Click [Toggle BT Permission ON/OFF] on mobile -> 2) Enter Admin Console (security PIN) -> 3) Enter +20 km on the actual odometer and click [Run Audit]
ExpectedResults_CheckPoints: Alert fires immediately when permission is turned off in the garage / On odometer discrepancy (+5 km or more) the employee with permissions OFF is auto-identified as Ghost Trip prime suspect (91% confidence)

ScenarioName: Admin 1-Click Preset Setup & 3-Field Vehicle/User CSV Bulk Upload
StepsSummary: 1) In Admin Console download [Simple CSV Template] and upload it as-is via [Vehicle CSV Bulk Upload] -> 2) In the policy tab click a [Mode A / B / C] preset card once
ExpectedResults_CheckPoints: Vehicle #31 auto-mapped and added using only plate and model (no Bluetooth MAC) / All 9 settings saved instantly with 1 click on a preset card

ScenarioName: Real Smartphone (iPhone / Android) Mobile Access & Live 6-Axis IMU Sensor Streaming
StepsSummary: 1) Open the deployed URL in a smartphone browser -> 2) Tap [Connect Phone Sensors] (GPS · 6-axis IMU) and allow permissions -> 3) Shake the phone and watch the G-Force change
ExpectedResults_CheckPoints: Real smartphone acceleration (G) and gyro rotation (°/s) shown live / Auto-sent to backend (/api/fleet/telemetry) when exceeding 2.5G
